author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Purism is turning to RISC-V for the next generation of its Librem 5 Linux smartphone. The upcoming Librem 5 v2 replaces the original model’s Arm-based processor with an eight-core SpacemiT K1, while retaining its modular, repairable design and hardware privacy switches. title: Librem 5 v2 Linux smartphone adopts eight-core RISC-V processor
